_comment: xp_wellys_atc - per-airport overrides (generic). Supplements Navigraph/apt.dat/atc.dat with hand-maintained per-ICAO data. Covers: (1) runway-in-use config (arrival/departure runways, wind-gated), (2) preferred approach by weather, (3) additional airport info (delegated controllers + freqs, AFIS/Tower names). Loaded from <plugin>/Resources/airport+.json. LOADER NOT BUILT YET (v4.4.0). Schema is PROVISIONAL - confirm before wiring.

runway_config: ordered, first match wins. {arrival, departure, max_tailwind_kt?, wind_min_dir?, wind_max_dir?}. arrival/departure may differ and be opposite. no wind field = always.
approaches: arrival-only. {runway, designator, min_vis_m?, max_vis_m?, min_ceiling_ft?, max_ceiling_ft?, min_rvr_m?}. first match (in file order) whose weather gates hold wins. gates use the DESTINATION METAR (dest_visibility_m / dest_ceiling_ft / per-runway RVR), not local DataRef.
controllers: additional airport info: controllers/freqs missing from atc.dat. {role, name, freq_mhz}. role = approach|tower|ground|delivery|atis|info.
